title: Crannog Ales
specs: Produces flagship Back Hand of God Stout and rotating seasonal ales.
Brewery by-products are reused on the farm for livestock feed, compost, and irrigation.
blurb: Crannóg Ales is an organic farmhouse brewery located on Left Fields organic farm in the Shuswap region of BC. They brew only organic ales using mostly ingredients from their own farm, including their own hops. The brewery emphasizes environmental stewardship, social responsibility, and sustainability, reusing all brewery by-products on the farm.
extraNote: We accept both our own and others' growlers for exchange at the current deposit rate ($5 for either size). We reserve the right to refuse growlers due to damage, size, colour or other issues. · We will accept non-Crannog growlers for exchange only, not refund, with a cap of 6 non-Crannóg growlers. · We don't ship growlers! We distribute growlers directly within our drop-off and market areas, as shown in our Contact page. · Swag can be picked up with your beer order, or can be mailed if ordered separately. Charges apply, select your option at checkout.
